CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Percussion Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
